core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haaji corresponds to the Arabic form حاجي (Arabic root ح ج ج (ḥ-j-j); حاجّ (ḥājj)). Its core sense is pilgrim (one who performs the hajj). Haaji is Arabic حاجّ / حاجي (Ḥājj) 'pilgrim, one who has performed the Hajj', from the root ح ج ج (ḥ-j-j). The word is not the same as حجر 'stone'. It is used as an acquired title after the pilgrimage and as an element of personal names.
